result.reason: The additions address Affiliate/contractor use, M&A assignment, and uncured material-breach termination in concept, but they leave directly conflicting operative provisions intact. The Change of Control clause still automatically terminates the agreement absent Licensor consent, defeating successor transferability, while Article IV still permits immediate termination for any breach. The employee-only and anti-sublicensing restrictions also remain and are addressed only through a potentially ambiguous deeming provision. No perpetual and irrevocable treatment is provided for any paid-up licence. The drafting is targeted to the playbook topics and generally preserves unrelated terms, but it is unnecessarily duplicative, extends coverage expressly to introducing brokers beyond the stated position, and should conform the existing restrictions rather than layer contradictory language over them.
